item6_definition_hash_determinism.evidence: Direct byte-level inspection of the live systematic-debugging SKILL.md in the plugin cache: 0 CRLF pairs, 283 bare LF, pure LF despite this machine's core.autocrlf=true (global and local). Root-caused: the cache tree has no .git directory (archive-based extraction, not git clone+checkout, so core.autocrlf is never applied), AND upstream obra/superpowers' own committed .gitattributes declares '*.md text eol=lf' (an attribute that would override local core.autocrlf even under a checkout-based mechanism). Cross-checked installed_plugins.json's own recorded gitCommitSha (b36e0829c6d0140e93cfef2ca599b1b07d4a7797) - a THIRD independent confirmation of the same provenance chain, matching plugin_sources.pinned_commit_sha and the gh api result. Disclosed, not fixed: this repo's own .gitattributes/#48 fix has zero effect on this file (outside the repo entirely); a future plugin source without its own eol=lf discipline would be exposed to #48's original fragility with no mitigation available at the Brain OS repo level. Documented in KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES #51(c).
